paper.title: Zero-Shot to New Robots: Introducing Dream-1
paper.venue: Official web page (Dream Labs Research blog); not a paper

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Research . October 2026 — **Zero-Shot to New Robots: Introducing Dream-1**
blocks.translation: 研究 · 2026 年 10 月 —— **零样本迁移到新机器人：Dream-1 发布**

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: Today, we're releasing Dream-1, a World Action Model that controls robots it has never seen, performs tasks it was never shown, and runs from \$3/hour.
blocks.translation: 今天，我们发布 Dream-1：一个世界动作模型，它能控制从未见过的机器人、执行从未被示范过的任务，且运行成本低至每小时 3 美元起。

blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: The Dream Labs team . October 2026 . 10 min read
blocks.translation: Dream Labs 团队 · 2026 年 10 月 · 阅读时长 10 分钟

blocks.label: Para. 4
blocks.original_text: Give Dream-1 a new bimanual robot with parallel grippers, connect it to our API, and it can start performing tasks out of the box. No fine-tuning, no demonstrations from that robot, and no machine learning expertise required.
blocks.translation: 给 Dream-1 一台新的、配备平行夹爪的双臂机器人，把它接入我们的 API，它就能开箱即用地开始执行任务。无需微调，无需来自该机器人的示范，也不需要机器学习专业知识。

blocks.label: Para. 5
blocks.original_text: This is an important step toward general-purpose robot intelligence.
blocks.translation: 这是迈向通用机器人智能的重要一步。

blocks.label: Para. 6
blocks.original_text: Today, Dream Labs is also coming out of stealth with \$90M in seed funding and making Dream-1 available to people all around the world through a public API.
blocks.translation: 今天，Dream Labs 也正式结束隐身状态，宣布获得 9000 万美元种子轮融资，并通过公共 API 向全球用户开放 Dream-1。

blocks.label: Para. 7
blocks.original_text: **From day one** — Dream-1 controls robots it has never seen, on tasks it was never shown, in places it has never been, from \$3/hour.
blocks.translation: **从第一天起** —— Dream-1 就能在从未到过的地方、以从未被示范过的任务，控制从未见过的机器人，成本低至每小时 3 美元起。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: For decades, robotics has been stuck in a chicken-and-egg problem: a robot needs to be useful before people want to buy it, but making it useful requires data from that exact robot, and that data only exists once enough people start using it. Dream-1 is our first step toward breaking that loop.
blocks.translation: 几十年来，机器人领域一直困在“先有鸡还是先有蛋”的问题里：机器人必须先有用，人们才愿意购买；但要让它有用，就需要来自这台具体机器人的数据，而这些数据只有在足够多的人开始使用它之后才会存在。Dream-1 是我们打破这一循环的第一步。

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: Self-driving found a way around this cold-start problem. Cars were useful from day one with zero autonomy, so millions of people drove them every day and generated the data needed to train increasingly capable models. Most other robots never had that advantage.
blocks.translation: 自动驾驶找到了绕过这一冷启动问题的办法。汽车在零自主能力时从第一天起就是有用的，于是数以百万计的人每天驾驶它们，产生了训练日益强大的模型所需的数据。大多数其他机器人从未拥有这种优势。

blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: Two things are changing that.
blocks.translation: 有两件事正在改变这一局面。

blocks.label: Para. 4
blocks.original_text: First, robot hardware is getting cheap enough to reach far more people. A capable bimanual arm setup can now cost as little as [\$2k](https://www.makermods.ai/maker-arm)<sup>[1](#fn-1-maker-arm)</sup>.
blocks.translation: 第一，机器人硬件正变得足够便宜，可以触达多得多的人。一套能力不错的双臂机械臂系统如今最低只需 [2000 美元](https://www.makermods.ai/maker-arm)<sup>[1](#fn-1-maker-arm)</sup>。

blocks.label: Para. 5
blocks.original_text: Second, a robot may no longer need a large dataset of its own before it can be useful. If a model can generalize zero-shot to unseen environments, tasks, and even robots, a new robot can start with useful capabilities.
blocks.translation: 第二，机器人在变得有用之前，可能不再需要一个属于它自己的大规模数据集。如果一个模型能零样本泛化到未见过的环境、任务乃至机器人，那么一台新机器人一开始就能具备有用的能力。

blocks.label: Para. 6
blocks.original_text: Put those together and the flywheel can finally start. Cheaper hardware puts more robots into the world. Generalizable models make those robots useful earlier. Useful robots generate more data, and that data makes the models better for the next robot.
blocks.translation: 把两者结合起来，飞轮终于可以转动。更便宜的硬件让更多机器人进入世界；可泛化的模型让这些机器人更早变得有用；有用的机器人产生更多数据，而这些数据又让模型对下一台机器人更好。

blocks.section: 02 The Cambrian explosion of cheap, affordable robots
blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Robot hardware is getting cheap faster than anyone expected. See the robots above, where 7 semi-humanoid robots cost less than \$15k, a price tier that barely existed a year ago. At the far end of the price curve, Hugging Face's \$399 Microduck sold more than 10,000 units within 4 days of its launch in late August<sup>[2](#fn-2-microduck)</sup>. We believe the robotics take-off will start with robots like these.
blocks.translation: 机器人硬件变便宜的速度超出了所有人的预期。看看上面的机器人：其中有 7 款半人形机器人售价低于 1.5 万美元，而这一价位一年前几乎还不存在。在价格曲线的最低端，Hugging Face 售价 399 美元的 Microduck 在 8 月下旬发布后 4 天内售出超过 10,000 台<sup>[2](#fn-2-microduck)</sup>。我们相信，机器人的腾飞将从这样的机器人开始。

blocks.section: 02 The Cambrian explosion of cheap, affordable robots
blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text:
Key figures (stat cards on the page):

- **\$2,000** — a bimanual arm setup: A capable two-arm setup, as of today.
- **7** — semi-humanoids under \$15k: Wheels, two arms, parallel grippers; a tier that barely existed a year ago.
- **\$399** — Hugging Face Microduck: Launched late August.
- **10,000+** — Microducks in 4 days: Sold within four days of launch.<sup>[2](#fn-2-microduck)</sup>
blocks.translation:
关键数字（页面上的统计卡片）：

- **2,000 美元** —— 一套双臂机械臂系统：截至目前，一套能力不错的双臂系统的价格。
- **7 款** —— 低于 1.5 万美元的半人形机器人：轮式底盘、双臂、平行夹爪；这一价位一年前几乎还不存在。
- **399 美元** —— Hugging Face Microduck：8 月下旬发布。
- **10,000+ 台** —— 4 天内售出的 Microduck：发布后四天内售出。<sup>[2](#fn-2-microduck)</sup>

blocks.section: 02 The Cambrian explosion of cheap, affordable robots
blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: That's because their buyers are consumers, prosumers, and small teams, not enterprises. An enterprise buyer is making a spreadsheet decision. If the robot doesn't beat a person on cost, speed, or reliability, it doesn't get bought; that's a high bar to clear. Consumers are different. 10,000+ people just paid \$399 within 4 days for a robot whose main job is to be delightful and cute: it walks, waddles, and roller-skates. Somewhere between that and a fully capable home robot is a sweet spot, a robot affordable enough to be an easy yes and useful enough to earn its place in the home. Once robots hit that point, we think adoption starts to compound, and every robot in a home becomes a source of new training data. Imagine two Microducks folding your laundry, using their beaks as grippers.
blocks.translation: 这是因为它们的买家是消费者、专业消费者（prosumer）和小团队，而不是企业。企业买家做的是“电子表格式”的决策：如果机器人在成本、速度或可靠性上比不过人，就不会被购买——这是一道很高的门槛。消费者则不同。10,000 多人刚刚在 4 天内花 399 美元买下一台主要任务只是讨人喜欢、可爱的机器人：它会走路、摇摇摆摆地踱步，还会滑旱冰。在它与一台全能家用机器人之间，存在一个甜蜜点：一台便宜到让人毫不犹豫地买下、又有用到足以在家中占据一席之地的机器人。我们认为，一旦机器人达到这一点，普及就会开始复利式增长，每台家中的机器人都会成为新训练数据的来源。想象一下，两只 Microduck 用它们的喙当夹爪，帮你叠衣服。

blocks.section: 03 The result that started Dream Labs
blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: In February 2026, [our team](https://dreamlabs.ai/team/) released DreamZero, the paper that introduced [World Action Models](https://dreamzero0.github.io/)<sup>[3](#fn-3-dreamzero)</sup>. Since then, the community has adopted WAMs as one of the most promising paradigms in robot learning. At that time, the most surprising result for us was when after post-training DreamZero on just 30 minutes of YAM robot data, we saw it generalize zero-shot to tasks it had never seen. That kind of generalization used to take hundreds or even thousands of hours of embodiment-specific data. If 30 minutes of data from a given robot was enough to transfer general-purpose task knowledge to that robot, breaking the chicken-and-egg loop no longer looked impossible. Combined with the hardware wave above, the timing felt right. That's when we decided to start Dream Labs.
blocks.translation: 2026 年 2 月，[我们的团队](https://dreamlabs.ai/team/)发布了 DreamZero——提出[世界动作模型](https://dreamzero0.github.io/)的论文<sup>[3](#fn-3-dreamzero)</sup>。自那以后，社区已将 WAM 视为机器人学习中最有前景的范式之一。当时，最让我们惊讶的结果是：仅用 30 分钟的 YAM 机器人数据对 DreamZero 进行后训练后，我们看到它零样本泛化到了从未见过的任务上。这种程度的泛化过去需要数百甚至数千小时的特定形态数据。如果来自某台机器人的 30 分钟数据就足以把通用任务知识迁移到这台机器人上，那么打破“鸡与蛋”循环就不再显得不可能。再结合上文所述的硬件浪潮，时机似乎恰到好处。正是在那时，我们决定创立 Dream Labs。

blocks.section: 03 The result that started Dream Labs
blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: After six months of building, we're excited to share a new research breakthrough that was only made possible through world action models: early signs of zero-shot embodiment generalization.
blocks.translation: 经过六个月的构建，我们很高兴分享一项只有借助世界动作模型才得以实现的新研究突破：零样本形态泛化的早期迹象。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Dream-1 is our first World Action Model available through a public API that can be used all around the world. Out of the box, it can control unseen robots for unseen tasks in unseen environments.
blocks.translation: Dream-1 是我们首个通过公共 API 提供、可在全球范围内使用的世界动作模型。它开箱即可在未见过的环境中、针对未见过的任务控制未见过的机器人。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: We want generalizable robotics to be accessible to anyone with a robot, not just large labs. So we designed Dream-1 to be as close to plug-and-play as possible. Connect your robot, point it at the API, and run. No machine learning background is needed to get started. Every week, we run internal hackathons to keep time-to-deploy as short as possible. [Getting started tutorial](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai/setup-api)
blocks.translation: 我们希望可泛化的机器人技术能为任何拥有机器人的人所用，而不仅限于大型实验室。因此，我们把 Dream-1 设计得尽可能接近即插即用：连接你的机器人，把它指向 API，然后运行。上手无需任何机器学习背景。我们每周都会举办内部黑客松，以尽量缩短部署所需时间。[入门教程](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai/setup-api)

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: Condensed client side code. *(Listing caption on the page. Reader note: `<API_KEY>` is a placeholder shown as-is; `dreamlabs/dream-1` is the checkpoint identifier; as printed, the listing is condensed and not directly runnable Python.)*
blocks.translation: 精简版客户端代码。*（页面上的代码清单说明。阅读稿注：`<API_KEY>` 为页面原样显示的占位符；`dreamlabs/dream-1` 为检查点标识符；按页面原样，该清单为精简版，不能直接作为 Python 运行。）*

blocks.section: 04.2 Zero-shot on robots it has never seen
blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Dream-1 can zero-shot generalize to many bimanual, parallel-gripper robots. Here are some we've tested. It can even control the original PR2, a general-purpose bimanual research robot released 18 years ago. Note that no embodiment-specific data was used to get these rollouts.
blocks.translation: Dream-1 能零样本泛化到许多双臂、平行夹爪机器人上。以下是我们测试过的一部分。它甚至能控制最初的 PR2——一款 18 年前发布的通用双臂研究机器人。请注意，获得这些执行回合时没有使用任何特定形态的数据。

blocks.section: 04.2 Zero-shot on robots it has never seen
blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: This is one of the first reported zero-shot generalizations to completely unseen robot embodiments.<sup>[4](#fn-4-lap)</sup> If you have a bimanual parallel-gripper robot, try prompting Dream-1 and let us know how it goes. Zero-shot performance depends partly on your robot's inverse kinematics (IK) solver, so we've written a guide to help you get the most out of it. [IK guide](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai/docs/). Performance also varies across robots. Below, we break down zero-shot performance in simulation and on real robots.
blocks.translation: 这是最早报道的、向完全未见过的机器人形态进行零样本泛化的成果之一。<sup>[4](#fn-4-lap)</sup>如果你有一台双臂平行夹爪机器人，不妨试着给 Dream-1 下指令，并告诉我们效果如何。零样本性能部分取决于你的机器人的逆运动学（IK）求解器，因此我们编写了一份指南，帮助你充分发挥它的能力：[IK 指南](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai/docs/)。性能也因机器人而异。下面我们分别给出仿真和真实机器人上的零样本性能细分。

blocks.section: 04.2 Zero-shot on robots it has never seen
blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: Below, we explain how zero-shot embodiment generalization works and where it falls short. We then show how one-shot embodiment learning closes that gap.
blocks.translation: 下面我们解释零样本形态泛化是如何实现的、又在哪些方面有所不足，随后展示单次形态学习如何弥合这一差距。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: **Two ways to control a robot: joints or end-effectors.** Robot policies commonly output joint angles, which ties them to one specific robot's body. Dream-1 can do the same for the embodiments it supports natively, but it can also predict end-effector (EEF) poses: where each gripper should be and whether it should be open or closed. Every robot with two arms and parallel grippers shares that EEF action space, and its own IK solver turns the poses into joint commands. That shared interface gives Dream-1 a common way to command robots it has never seen, but on its own it isn't enough to make zero-shot transfer work.
blocks.translation: **控制机器人的两种方式：关节或末端执行器。** 机器人策略通常输出关节角，这会把策略绑定在某一台特定机器人的本体上。对于它原生支持的形态，Dream-1 也可以这样做；但它还能预测末端执行器（EEF）位姿：每个夹爪应处于何处，以及应张开还是闭合。每台拥有双臂和平行夹爪的机器人都共享这一 EEF 动作空间，再由其自身的 IK 求解器把位姿转换为关节指令。这一共享接口为 Dream-1 提供了指挥从未见过的机器人的通用方式，但仅凭它本身，还不足以让零样本迁移奏效。

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: **Why does this work?** Dream-1 sees the world through three cameras: a head view and a wrist view on each arm. Prior work on the [Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI)](https://umi-gripper.github.io/) showed that policies can transfer zero-shot across robot arms when every arm uses the same gripper and the policy relies only on wrist cameras<sup>[5](#fn-5-umi)</sup>. From the wrist's point of view, the robots look identical. But that shortcut has a hard limit. It only works when the gripper hardware matches exactly, and it gives up the head camera's view of the whole scene.
blocks.translation: **为什么这能奏效？** Dream-1 通过三台相机观察世界：一个头部视角，以及每条手臂上的一个腕部视角。此前关于[通用操控接口（UMI）](https://umi-gripper.github.io/)的工作表明，当每条手臂使用相同的夹爪、且策略只依赖腕部相机时，策略可以在不同机械臂之间零样本迁移<sup>[5](#fn-5-umi)</sup>。从腕部的视角看，这些机器人看起来完全相同。但这条捷径有一个硬性限制：它只在夹爪硬件完全一致时才有效，并且放弃了头部相机对整个场景的视野。

blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: World Action Models remove that limit. A WAM learns to predict video and actions together, so controlling a robot and imagining what that robot will do are the same problem. And every robot shows up the same way: as pixels. The head camera sees a UMI gripper, a two-finger gripper or an arm Dream-1 has never met as nothing more than shapes moving through a scene, which makes video the one representation every robot type shares. If Dream-1 can predict what a robot will look like as it completes a task, it can produce the actions that get it there. That’s why it can control robots with grippers that look nothing like UMI’s, and even entirely new bodies seen through the head camera.
blocks.translation: 世界动作模型消除了这一限制。WAM 学习同时预测视频与动作，因此“控制一台机器人”与“想象这台机器人将做什么”是同一个问题。而且每台机器人都以同样的方式呈现：像素。在头部相机看来，UMI 夹爪、二指夹爪或 Dream-1 从未遇到过的机械臂，都不过是在场景中移动的形状——这使视频成为所有机器人类型共享的唯一表征。如果 Dream-1 能预测一台机器人在完成任务时看起来会是什么样，它就能生成让机器人到达那一状态的动作。这就是为什么它能控制夹爪外观与 UMI 完全不同的机器人，甚至能控制通过头部相机看到的全新本体。

blocks.label: Para. 4
blocks.original_text:
**Limitations** — Predicting EEF trades some control for generality. Compared with joint-angle prediction with per-embodiment adaptation:

- Performance depends on the quality of each robot's IK solver.
- Dream-1 doesn't control how the arm reaches a pose, only where the gripper ends up, which can matter around obstacles or near joint limits.
- Robots whose workspace or kinematics / dynamics differ sharply from what Dream-1 has seen may predict future states that are infeasible.
blocks.translation:
**局限性** —— 预测 EEF 是以牺牲部分控制力换取通用性。与针对每种形态进行适配的关节角预测相比：

- 性能取决于每台机器人 IK 求解器的质量。
- Dream-1 并不控制手臂如何到达某个位姿，只控制夹爪最终到达何处；在障碍物附近或接近关节极限时，这一点可能很重要。
- 对于工作空间或运动学／动力学与 Dream-1 所见过的差异极大的机器人，（模型）可能会预测出不可行的未来状态。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Ahead of launch, [Robocurve](https://robocurve.org/)<sup>[6](#fn-6-robocurve)</sup>, a Public Benefit Corporation that measures and reports frontier robotics capabilities to the public, evaluated Dream-1 independently. Their report, above, shows Dream-1 is better, faster and cheaper: a new Pareto frontier for robot control. It scores above the next best models, Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, at 16x lower cost per task attempt than Gemini 4 Argon and 1.7x faster than the fastest LLM, GPT-6 Astra. While current LLMs excel at planning, robots still require a fast, general System 1 to act, and that is what Dream-1 is built to be.
blocks.translation: 在发布之前，[Robocurve](https://robocurve.org/)<sup>[6](#fn-6-robocurve)</sup>——一家衡量并向公众报告前沿机器人能力的公益公司（Public Benefit Corporation）——对 Dream-1 进行了独立评测。上方的报告显示，Dream-1 更好、更快、更便宜：为机器人控制确立了新的帕累托前沿。它的得分高于次优模型 Opus 5.5 和 Gemini 4 Argon，每次任务尝试的成本比 Gemini 4 Argon 低 16 倍，速度比最快的 LLM GPT-6 Astra 快 1.7 倍。尽管当前的 LLM 擅长规划，机器人仍然需要一个快速、通用的“系统 1”来执行动作，而这正是 Dream-1 的设计定位。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: **How much does it cost to run Dream-1?** We want you to know exactly what to expect before you try it. Running the model costs just \$3 per hour for Dream-1, or \$2 per hour for Dream-1-flash. Each call to the model returns 1.6 seconds of actions, so an hour is 2,250 calls: about \$0.0013 an action for Dream-1, and \$0.0009 for Dream-1-flash.
blocks.translation: **运行 Dream-1 需要多少钱？** 我们希望你在尝试之前就确切知道会花多少。运行 Dream-1 每小时仅需 3 美元，Dream-1-flash 每小时 2 美元。每次调用模型返回 1.6 秒的动作，因此一小时为 2,250 次调用：Dream-1 每次动作约 0.0013 美元，Dream-1-flash 约 0.0009 美元。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text:
Pricing cards:

- **\$3 / hour — Dream-1**: Everything above the hourly cost is yours to keep.
- **\$2 / hour — Dream-1-flash**: The faster, lighter model.
blocks.translation:
价格卡片：

- **每小时 3 美元 —— Dream-1**：超出小时成本的部分全归你所有。
- **每小时 2 美元 —— Dream-1-flash**：更快、更轻量的模型。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 4
blocks.original_text: **Across tasks.** We break Dream-1’s performance down into eight task categories, from what it handles well to where it still struggles.
blocks.translation: **跨任务表现。** 我们把 Dream-1 的性能细分为八个任务类别，从它擅长的到它仍有困难的。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 5
blocks.original_text: **Fine-tune for your task with FaaS.** If Dream-1 falls short on a task you care about, you don’t have to wait for our next release. Collect some data on your own robot, run it through FaaS, and get a custom model built for that task.
blocks.translation: **用 FaaS 为你的任务微调。** 如果 Dream-1 在你关心的任务上表现不足，你不必等待我们的下一个版本。在你自己的机器人上采集一些数据，通过 FaaS 处理，就能得到一个为该任务定制的模型。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 6
blocks.original_text: We want anyone with a robot to work like a forward-deployed engineer: find a task someone needs done, collect a bit of data, adapt Dream-1 to it, and deploy. If people will pay for what your robot does, you keep everything above the hourly cost.
blocks.translation: 我们希望任何拥有机器人的人都能像前线部署工程师那样工作：找到一个有人需要完成的任务，采集一点数据，让 Dream-1 适配它，然后部署。如果人们愿意为你的机器人所做的事付费，超出小时成本的部分都归你。

blocks.section: 04.4 What Dream-1 can and can't do
blocks.label: Para. 7
blocks.original_text: **Dream-1 is a research beta.** It will make mistakes, and it has not been validated for safety-critical use. Please test it in controlled settings, and take extra care whenever a robot is running near people. If you see unsafe behavior, please report it to [safety@dreamlabs.ai](mailto:safety@dreamlabs.ai).
blocks.translation: **Dream-1 是研究测试版（research beta）。** 它会犯错，且尚未针对安全关键用途进行验证。请在受控环境中测试，并在机器人靠近人员运行时格外小心。如果发现不安全行为，请报告至 [safety@dreamlabs.ai](mailto:safety@dreamlabs.ai)。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: When zero-shot isn't enough, we fine-tune Dream-1 for your robot. We call this Fine-tuning-as-a-Service (FaaS).
blocks.translation: 当零样本不够用时，我们会为你的机器人微调 Dream-1。我们称之为“微调即服务”（FaaS）。

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: Here's what that looks like in practice: timelapses of data collection on two of our partners' robots, 5 minutes each.
blocks.translation: 实际情况如下：在我们两家合作方的机器人上进行数据采集的延时视频，每台各 5 分钟。

blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: After adapting on just those 5 minutes, the difference shows side-by-side with the zero-shot run. Dream-1 now understands a bit better the affordance and kinematics of the robot.
blocks.translation: 仅用这 5 分钟数据完成适配后，与零样本运行并排对比即可看出差异。Dream-1 现在对该机器人的可供性（affordance）与运动学理解得更好了一些。

blocks.label: Para. 4
blocks.original_text: Some embodiments sit much further from what Dream-1 already knows, and closing a gap that large takes more of the robot’s own data. Dexmate with Sharpa dexterous hands grasps with hands in place of grippers, and took 77 minutes of its data. On YAM, we swapped in different end effectors for this task, a compliant gripper and a modified knife gripper, and it took 98 minutes of data.
blocks.translation: 有些形态与 Dream-1 已知的相差甚远，弥合如此大的差距需要更多该机器人自身的数据。配备 Sharpa 灵巧手的 Dexmate 用手而非夹爪进行抓取，用了 77 分钟的自身数据。在 YAM 上，我们为这项任务换装了不同的末端执行器——一个柔顺夹爪和一个改装的刀具夹爪——用了 98 分钟的数据。

blocks.label: Para. 5
blocks.original_text: Across twelve robots from our FaaS beta partners, fine-tuning lifts the language-following score on ten of them:
blocks.translation: 在来自我们 FaaS 测试合作方的十二台机器人中，微调提升了其中十台的语言遵循得分：

blocks.label: Para. 6
blocks.original_text: One-shot adaptation still outperforms zero-shot, so a gap remains. Closing it is one of our main goals: the better zero-shot gets, the closer any new robot comes to working out of the box.
blocks.translation: 单次适配仍优于零样本，因此差距依然存在。弥合这一差距是我们的主要目标之一：零样本越好，任何新机器人就越接近开箱即用。

blocks.label: Para. 1
blocks.original_text: Dream-1 today is a manipulation policy for bimanual robots with parallel grippers. It’s a starting point. We believe a strong, general robot foundation model can extend to mobile manipulators, dexterous hands, and bodies we haven't imagined yet, opening up many more of the things people actually want robots to do. Robotics won't be solved on day one, and Dream-1 has real limits, which we've tried to show transparently above.
blocks.translation: 如今的 Dream-1 是一个面向配备平行夹爪的双臂机器人的操控策略。这是一个起点。我们相信，一个强大、通用的机器人基础模型可以扩展到移动操作机器人、灵巧手，以及我们尚未想象到的本体，从而解锁更多人们真正希望机器人去做的事。机器人问题不会在第一天就被解决，Dream-1 也有真实的局限，我们已尽力在上文中透明地展示。

blocks.label: Para. 2
blocks.original_text: Robotics is still stuck in a difficult loop: every new robot or task demands new data and a custom policy, often with limited generalization. With Dream-1 as a robotics API, we want to break that loop and put robot intelligence into more people's hands, so everyday users, not only researchers, can discover new applications for general-purpose robot intelligence.
blocks.translation: 机器人领域仍困在一个艰难的循环中：每一台新机器人或每一项新任务都需要新数据和定制策略，且泛化能力往往有限。借助作为机器人 API 的 Dream-1，我们希望打破这一循环，把机器人智能交到更多人手中，让普通用户——而不只是研究人员——也能为通用机器人智能发掘新的应用。

blocks.label: Para. 3
blocks.original_text: **Dream-1 . public API — Put Dream‑1 on your robot.** If you're building robots or putting them to work on real tasks, we want Dream-1 to be the fastest way to make them useful. Tell us what you're working on. [Use Dream-1 Today](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai) · [Work with us](mailto:info@dreamlabs.co)
blocks.translation: **Dream-1 · 公共 API —— 把 Dream-1 装到你的机器人上。** 如果你正在制造机器人，或让它们投入真实任务，我们希望 Dream-1 成为让它们变得有用的最快方式。告诉我们你在做什么。[立即使用 Dream-1](https://platform.dreamlabs.ai) · [与我们合作](mailto:info@dreamlabs.co)
